name: Jonathan Ontiveros
office: City of Burbank, Member of the City Council

items.text: Jonathan Ontiveros is a civil engineering professional running for Burbank City Council. He is a senior civil engineering assistant with Los Angeles County Public Works and a director with the California Association of Professional Employees. His candidate statement says his priorities include modernizing the city's housing approach, strengthening relationships with businesses, and keeping neighborhoods safe.

items.text: At a September 2026 League of Women Voters forum, he said the city must first address its general fund deficit. He also said four specific city plans could yield nearly 16,000 housing units, adding that some have not been updated since the 1990s.
